activity.notes: Leonardo Loredan was elected Doge of Venice in 1501 and served until his death in 1521. His dogeship encompassed the War of the League of Cambrai and the republic's recovery of key mainland possessions. ATLAS records the elected dogeship as a governing term.

sources.title: Leonardo Loredan — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani identifies Loredan as Doge of Venice from his election in 1501 until his death in 1521.
